title: Conformational change induced by binding of Mn(2+) ions activates SloR transcription factor in Streptococcus mutans.
authors: Radman, Katarina; Crnolatac, Ivo; Bregovic, Nikola; Matosevic, Zoe Jelic; Fernandes, Pedro A; Merunka, Dalibor; Zilic, Dijana; Piantanida, Ivo; Asler, Ivana Lescic; Bertosa, Branimir
one_liner_zh: 该文通过QM/MD模拟结合实验研究Mn(2+)诱导SloR转录因子构象变化以增强其DNA结合亲和力的机制，属于TF-DNA互作体系，但方法侧重金属离子效应而非直接结合位点预测或界面建模。
abstract: Streptococcus mutans, a bacterium commonly found in the human oral cavity, is considered the primary causative agent of dental caries. A key player in the pathophysiology of S. mutans is SloR, a 25-kDa metalloregulatory protein. SloR plays a crucial role in coordinating the uptake of essential metal ions, particularly manganese, with the transcription of the bacterium's virulence genes. To elucidate the molecular mechanism underlying the enhanced binding affinity of SloR to DNA upon Mn(2+) ion binding, a combination of computational (QM and MD) and experimental (ITC, DSC, CD, EPR) methods have been employed. Computational simulations revealed that Mn(2+) binding induces a conformational change of SloR, primarily affecting the positioning of its DNA-binding domains, bringing them to an appropriate position for DNA binding. Consequently, the protein's DNA binding affinity is modulated. Additionally, experimental findings indicate that the SloR monomer binds up to three Mn(2+) ions and that the thermodynamic stability of SloR increases upon Mn(2+) complexation. The presented computational results also suggest that Mn(2+) binding at the primary binding sites is sufficient to trigger the observed conformational change in SloR.
abstract_zh: 变形链球菌（Streptococcus mutans）是一种常见于人类口腔的细菌，被认为是龋齿的主要致病因子。在S. mutans的病理生理过程中，SloR蛋白（一种25-kDa金属调控蛋白）扮演关键角色。SloR在协调必需金属离子（尤其是锰离子）的摄取与细菌毒力基因的转录中发挥重要作用。为阐明Mn(2+)离子结合后SloR对DNA结合亲和力增强的分子机制，采用了计算（QM和MD）与实验（ITC、DSC、CD、EPR）相结合的方法。计算模拟揭示，Mn(2+)结合诱导SloR发生构象变化，主要影响其DNA结合域的位置，使其处于适合DNA结合的适当方位，从而调节蛋白质的DNA结合亲和力。此外，实验结果表明，SloR单体最多可结合三个Mn(2+)离子，且Mn(2+)络合后SloR的热力学稳定性增加。所呈现的计算结果还提示，初级结合位点的Mn(2+)结合足以触发观察到的SloR构象变化。
